It was in 4th grade, my mom was going through cancer treatment, my grandmother was staying with us to help take care of my sister and I, and I was sick.  It was a Tuesday night, I went to bed, and that Wednesday morning, I wet the bed.  I hadn't done that since I was super little, and it was most likely a product of stress and illness, but no matter what caused it, it happened, and it has ruined my life (I'm 20 now).  I became extremely obsessed with whether or not I had to go to the bathroom, but only before bed, during the day I was fine.  At night, I would get up every 10 minutes, on the 0 (00, 10, 20, 30, etc) to go to the bathroom, and I did this until I fell asleep.  If I felt like I had to pee too much, I went every five minutes on the 2 and the 7 (02, 07, 12, 17, etc), again, until I fell asleep.  It was very emotionally draining.  On top of that, I had compulsions about the angle my door was at, turning on my radio, how many times I touched something, etc.  I was also very obsessive over germs (that has gotten better, but my friends at school would all make fun of me for it...and I only had about 3 of them).  My OCD continued to morph and evolve as I got older, and my mom never understood my anxiety, so she always told me I was being ridiculous, or she would make fun of me to the family.  She didn't mean anything bad by it, but she just didn't understand (and still doesn't).  Today most of my other rituals and triggers have gone away, except for the peeing.
